easy.question: What is the total revenue from all orders?

medium.question: Which user placed the most orders?
medium.gold_sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

medium.question: What is the average order total?
Show me the 3 most expensive orders.
medium.gold_sql: SELECT id, total FROM orders ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3

medium.question: How many orders did each user place?
medium.gold_sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id

hard.question: Which user spent the most money in total?
hard.gold_sql: SELECT u.name, SUM(o.total) AS total_spent FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1

hard.question: What is the revenue per user for users who placed more than 3 orders?
hard.gold_sql: SELECT u.name, SUM(o.total) AS revenue FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 3

hard.question: What is the average order value by user, ordered from highest to lowest?
hard.gold_sql: SELECT u.name, AVG(o.total) AS avg_order FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY avg_order DESC
